purpose: Targeted follow-up for prettyboymp Blocks commits b5640b450b and d2a600204d: determine whether Blocks resource-hint and classic-theme asset enqueue work is a current hot path in the benchmark stack.

source_paths.note: Resource hints only run on frontend prefetch/prerender requests when wc()->cart has contents, then check whether cart/checkout pages contain the WooCommerce cart/checkout blocks.
Resource-hint data is cached in the woocommerce_block_asset_resource_hints transient, versioned by WooCommerce version, WordPress version, and site URL.
Store API initializes on non-admin requests; Blocks assets and block types initialize unless the request is specifically a Store API request.

setup.cart_state: A frontend cart cookie was populated with product 14 before requesting the variable product page.
setup.temporary_page_options: The benchmark's default cart/checkout pages are shortcodes, so temporary block cart/checkout pages were installed only for this profile, then the original options were restored.

direct_resource_hint_probe.method: WP-CLI reflection probe invoking AssetsController::get_block_asset_resource_hints() after clearing woocommerce_block_asset_resource_hints, then invoking the same filenames again warm.

finding: Blocks resource-hint generation is not a current bottleneck in the measured stack. The default benchmark cart/checkout pages are shortcode pages, so the path is normally inactive. Under a forced block-cart/block-checkout setup with a non-empty cart, cold cart+checkout hint generation costs about 16.215ms and 4 queries total, then warm cache hits cost about 0.053ms and 0 queries. The frontend product-page hot path remains AddToCartForm -> get_available_variations(), variation price generation, and WooPayments multicurrency hooks.
developer_handoff: Do not prioritize another resource-hint cache fix for this workload. If continuing the Blocks frontend lane, focus on block-template single-product rendering that forces full variation payload generation, and keep it tied to PRs #23-#25 plus WooPayments PR #11914 rather than the already-cached resource-hint path.
